# Jolnova

> Jolnova is a Windows desktop application that records live streams from Kick,
> Twitch, YouTube and TikTok, finds the moments worth keeping, and turns them
> into vertical 9:16 clips with burned-in subtitles. Every clip lands in a
> review queue — nothing is published unless the user approves it.

Jolnova runs on the user's own computer. Recording, moment detection and
transcription happen locally; the only step that leaves the machine is writing
the title of a clip the user already approved. There is no separate AI API key
to buy: it is included.

## What it does

- Tracks live channels on Kick, Twitch, YouTube and TikTok and records them while they are live.
- Processes links from those platforms plus hundreds of other sites, and local video files.
- Finds candidate moments from chat density, audio spikes and speech content.
- Sports mode: a second detector for match broadcasts that follows the commentary and the crowd, so goals, penalties and red cards come out as clips.
- Produces vertical 9:16 clips with burned-in, editable subtitles.
- Subtitle translation into English, Turkish, German, French and Spanish.
- Uploads approved clips to YouTube, immediately or at a scheduled time.

## Plans

Prices are monthly in USD. Checkout is not connected yet; the application can be
downloaded and used today.

- Free trial: 3 days or 50 clips, 2 channels, 720p, Jolnova watermark on.
- Solo — $4.99: one platform you choose, 3 channels, 100 approved clips a month, 1080p.
- Studio — $12.99: all four platforms, 15 channels, 500 approved clips a month, plus YouTube upload, sports mode and subtitle translation.
- Agency — $24.99: all four platforms, 50 channels, 2000 approved clips a month, 4K export where the source allows it, priority processing and support.

The monthly number counts clips the user **approves**, not clips the application
produces. A rejected clip costs nothing.

## Languages

English is the primary version at the root. Turkish, German, French and Spanish
live in their own folders and carry their own canonical URLs:
`/tr/`, `/de/`, `/fr/`, `/es/`.

## Facts worth stating correctly

- Jolnova is a desktop application for Windows 10 and 11. There is no web app and no mobile app.
- It does not post anything on its own. A clip is uploaded only if the user approves it and sets up an upload.
- Export resolution is a ceiling, not a promise: Twitch and Kick broadcast at 1080p at most, so a clip cut from those live streams is 1080p even on the Agency plan. 4K requires a 4K source.
- Clips are never deleted when a trial ends; what was already produced stays in the library.
- Jolnova does not download from sites that rebroadcast content without the rights to it.
